[[File:Twinflame staff.gif|thumb|300px|A player fires off two [[Fire Wave]]s using the Twinflame staff.]]
The '''Twinflame staff''' is a one-handed staff requiring level 60 [[Magic]] to wield. It is made by combining a [[battlestaff]] with the [[fire element staff crown]] and [[ice element staff crown]], obtained from looting [[Branda the Fire Queen]] and [[Eldric the Ice King]] respectively. It acts as an infinite source of [[fire rune|fire]] and [[water rune]]s when casting spells, like the [[steam battlestaff]].

The staff has an attack and cast speed of 6. It provides a 10% increase in accuracy and damage when casting spells from the [[standard spellbook]], and will automatically cast the appropriate elemental spell for an NPC with a different [[elemental weakness]] than what the player is autocasting, provided that the player has the required runes and Magic level for the selected spell. For example, a player with level 75 Magic attacking a [[moss giant]] with [[Wind Wave]] will instead cast [[Fire Wave]].

When attacking the walls during the [[Royal Titans]] fight, if a player has [[Death rune|death runes]] in their inventory and is auto-casting [[Wave spells]], the walls will be attacked using the relevant [[Blast spells|Blast spell]] for each type of wall, saving [[Blood rune|blood runes]] throughout multiple kills.

Additionally, when casting elemental spells (excluding [[Strike spells|Strike]] and [[Surge spells|Surge]] spells), the staff will [[Multi-hit weapons|fire off two spells at once]]; the second hit will land one tick after the first, dealing 40% of the damage dealt by the first, rounded down. Note that the second spell does not give Magic or Hitpoints experience, nor consume runes or any additional charges from the [[Tome of Fire]] or its other variants.

Taking into account the slower attack speed, the additional hit, and the 10% damage bonus, the twinflame staff has an effective damage bonus of 28%  for standard spellbook spells. Compared to other autocasting staves, it will typically outperform most options other than the [[dragon hunter wand]] (against dragons) and [[Harmonised Nightmare staff]] until 95 Magic, when [[Surge spells]] are at their full power. Compared to [[powered staves]], it is a stronger option for most enemies without an elemental weakness until ~80 Magic. Against opponents with an elemental weakness, it can outperform most powered staves other than the [[Tumeken's shadow]]. 

{{Bug|
* The damage and accuracy bonus also function while equipped on [[F2P]] worlds, even though the weapon behaves as if the player is unarmed and no double hitsplats occur.
* Damage from the staff when attacking an [[Elite Dark Mage]] does not make it switch its protection prayers, allowing the player to use just the magic attack style against it.<ref>[https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=r45UwudMnHc] Elite Dark Mage bug with the Twinflame staff 5/16/2026</ref>}}

==Sunfire rune effect==
Although the staff acts as an infinite source of fire runes, [[sunfire rune]]s and a [[tome of fire]] charged with [[searing page]]s '''can''' be used with the twinflame staff to increase the minimum hit of fire spells by 10%. However, this only applies to the first hit of each attack, not the bonus second hit.
{{bug|The +10% damage bonus from the tome of fire is not included when calculating the minimum hit for searing pages.}}
